summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A., a foreign private issuer, furnishing its second quarter 2026 earnings release under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing contains an executive summary and performance analysis of the bank's financial results, including net profit, loan portfolio growth, funding, and expense management. It does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or any other event-driven corporate action. No terms, prices, premiums, or deal mechanics are present. This is a standard periodic financial report, not a special-situation filing.
